label: TP
reason: Both alerts are true positives. Alert 1 (java/xss) has attacker-controlled data flowing directly to the sink expression at L68-L69 ('...' + bar + '...'). evidence.note: User input flows through decode(), into a HashMap, retrieved back into 'bar', and concatenated into both the XSS sink (response.getWriter().println(...)) and the SQL injection sink (queryForObject(sql, ...)).
